findings.summary: The new toggle has no persisted state (entity.Account has no calendar-access preference field) and no link to ext.device, so its 'off by default' setting and the calendar read permission it grants are not modeled anywhere.

Suggestion reasons now depend on device-calendar data, but no operation or link reads ext.device or calendar data. Suggestions are computed server-side by operation.goal.save and the scheduler, which cannot access the owner's device calendar, so the data source is missing.

The hook fixture now covers calendar reasons, but its criterion C.webapp.prompts.bounded and its source requirement S.webapp.prompts say nothing about calendar-derived reasons, so the hook tests behavior its criterion does not claim.
